questions.question: Which of the following is the most secure way to create a password for your accounts?
options: Use your birthdate and name
Use a simple sequence like '12345678'
Use a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols
Use the same password for all your accounts
questions.hint: The more complex and unique a password is, the harder it is for hackers to guess.

questions.question: What should you do if you receive an unexpected email from your 'bank' asking you to click a link and verify your account details?
options: Click the link and enter your details immediately
Reply to the email asking if it is real
Delete the email or report it as phishing
Forward the email to your friends to warn them
questions.hint: Legitimate banks will never ask for your password or sensitive data via an emailed link.

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of enabling Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) on your accounts?
options: It makes the login process faster
It encrypts all the files on your computer
It adds an extra layer of security beyond just a password
It prevents your computer from getting viruses
questions.hint: Think of it as requiring two different 'keys' to open a single door.

questions.question: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), what does the 'Right to Erasure' (Right to be Forgotten) allow individuals to do?
options: Delete their entire internet browsing history
Request that a company deletes their personal data
Hide their identity using a pseudonym
Block specific users from seeing their social media profile
questions.hint: This right focuses on the data a company holds about you, not your own device.

questions.question: When using a public Wi-Fi network, why is using a Virtual Private Network (VPN) considered a best practice for data security?
options: It increases the raw connection speed of the Wi-Fi
It automatically updates your device's operating system
It creates an encrypted tunnel for your data, hiding it from others on the network
It prevents your device from running out of battery
questions.hint: Focus on how data travels between your device and the internet in a public space.
